inherits.loader_semantics: cutting_tasks_v4.json / tasks._v4_task_config (base entry plus overrides; blade_rake_deg -> R_y(rho) edge orientation, tau = psi = 0)

freeze_boundary: Defined 2026-10-30 before any Phase F row ran (configs/wp11/phaseF_protocol_v1.json). Versioned variants needed by Phase F rows only: two TRIM-02-K2 rakes that cutting_tasks_v4 does not define (14 and 16 deg for the F2.1 theta_plow gate rows), the CUT-02 wide-bar geometry with the end-held v2 knife (F2.8), and the F2.11 supported slotted bar as a scene override plus a sequence goal. Each task inherits its v1 base task's thresholds unchanged; the v1-v4 protocols, task IDs and thresholds are unchanged. Loaded only by robotic_cutting_sim.law8_validation (opt-in); live runtimes never see these ids.
units: m, kg, s, deg, xyzw quaternions

TRIM-02-K2-R14.reason: Phase F2.1 gate row: TRIM-02-K2 family (TRIM-01 workpiece, fixture, path, edge clearance and thresholds; ruler_knife_v2_y double bevel) at rho = 14 deg, 1 deg below law 8's theta_plow = 15 deg.

TRIM-02-K2-R16.reason: Phase F2.1 gate row: TRIM-02-K2 family at rho = 16 deg, 1 deg above theta_plow = 15 deg.

CUT-04-K2-W60.reason: Phase F2.8 finite-edge row: the CUT-02 (cutting_tasks_v2) 160 x 60 x 25 mm bar, its wider pedestals and reference knots, with the end-held ruler_knife_v2_y held as in CUT-03-K2 (edge across the bar along +y, vertical in-plane cut, grip beyond the edge's -y end). CUT-01 thresholds (inherited, unused by the F2.8 criterion).

goal.description: Phase F2.11: three sequential through-cuts at local x = -48 / -16 / +16 mm over the board's relief slots (cut digits 0, 1, 2; four pieces), then a cut-disabled blade-face push of the +x piece by 10 mm from inside the x = +16 mm kerf. The goal evaluation is report-only; the F2.11 verdict is the Phase F protocol criterion.
